Class AlgoAlertSchedule

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.service.AlgoAlertSchedule
public final class AlgoAlertSchedule extends Object
Clock-independent market-session and due-time rules for the alerts. Persisted timestamps and quote timestamps are UTC.

    • window

      public static AlgoAlertSchedule.Window window(Instant now, boolean crypto, String zone, LocalTime open, LocalTime close, Set<LocalDate> holidays, int delaySeconds)
      Resolves the current session or today's final closing check. Weekends refer to the exchange's local date. Equal opening/closing times are invalid; cryptocurrency instruments explicitly bypass exchange restrictions.
